content.title: Tilray (TLRY) Shares Skyrocket, What You Need To Know
content.summary: Shares of cannabis company Tilray Brands (NASDAQ:TLRY) jumped 40.8% in the afternoon session after reports suggested the Trump administration planned to ease federal restrictions on marijuana by reclassifying it as a less dangerous substance.

content.title: Trump Lights Up the Cannabis Market With Plans for Reclassification
content.summary: The U.S. marijuana industry has stagnated for year, languishing under federal inaction on reclassification or decriminalization. Classified as a Schedule I drug under the Controlled Substances Act — alongside hard drugs like heroin and LSD — cannabis is deemed to have no accepted medical use and high abuse potential. content.title: Cannabis Stocks Surge. Trump May Reclassify Marijuana—but White House Says a Final Decision Hasn’t Been Made.
content.summary: Cannabis stocks  Tilray Brands  and  Canopy Growth  surged following reports that President Donald Trump would loosen federal restrictions on marijuana.  A White House official told Barron’s that no final decision had been made regarding the rescheduling of the drug.  The president indicated as far back as August that he was weighing the positives and negatives of a policy change.
